name: tray-icon-solid-glyph
title: Solid tray glyph without frame
description: Drop the hairline rounded-square frame from the system-tray icon and draw the arrow-over-bar glyph as one solid piece that fills the tile, so the whole mark reads bright on a dark Windows taskbar.
creator: Howard.J

meta.stale_build_incident: publish/win-x64/PTMonitor.exe was 10 s older than the artwork commit; the user reported 'still the old icon'. Republished and documented in frontend/quality-guidelines.md.
